measurements.name: product page
measurements.query: select id,name from public.workspace_product_stock where workspace_id=$1 order by updated_at desc,id limit 25

measurements.name: product exact count
measurements.query: select count(*)::bigint from public.workspace_product_stock where workspace_id=$1

measurements.name: product substring search
measurements.query: select id from public.workspace_product_stock where workspace_id=$1 and (name ilike '%raresearchtoken%' or sku ilike '%raresearchtoken%')

measurements.name: product SKU lookup
measurements.query: select id from public.products where workspace_id=$1 and sku='SKU-2000'

measurements.name: order substring search
measurements.query: select id from public.orders where workspace_id=$1 and (order_number ilike '%raresearchtoken%' or customer_name_snapshot ilike '%raresearchtoken%')

measurements.name: customer substring search
measurements.query: select id from public.customers where workspace_id=$1 and (full_name ilike '%raresearchtoken%' or email ilike '%raresearchtoken%' or phone ilike '%raresearchtoken%')

measurements.name: inventory state/category/quantity page
measurements.query: select id from public.workspace_inventory_stock where workspace_id=$1 and stock_status='low_stock' and category='category-0' and stock_quantity between 0 and 2 order by stock_quantity,id limit 25

measurements.name: customer order-count page
measurements.query: select id,order_count from public.workspace_customer_order_counts where workspace_id=$1 and order_count between 1 and 3 order by created_at desc,id limit 25

measurements.name: expense date/category page
measurements.query: select id from public.expenses where workspace_id=$1 and category='category-1' and expense_date between current_date-30 and current_date order by expense_date desc,id limit 25

measurements.name: expense exact count
measurements.query: select count(*)::bigint from public.expenses where workspace_id=$1 and category='category-1' and expense_date between current_date-30 and current_date

measurements.name: dashboard order aggregate
measurements.query: select count(*)::bigint as order_count,coalesce(sum(total),0)::numeric as gross_total from public.orders where workspace_id=$1
